keyword_or_accented.query: title/description keyword search with leading wildcard LIKE, sorted by views

keyword_or_accented_without_order.query: same keyword predicates without ORDER BY, exposing the full scan

description_normalized_only.query: description_normalized leading wildcard LIKE (the P9 column)

notes: liveSearch is cached by normalized keyword + limit for 300 seconds; cold flushes the cache before every sample.
advancedSearch is not cached and records a search_keywords write when q is present.
min_chapters uses a published-chapter EXISTS count, not the chapters_count alias.
Synthetic comics are created inside a transaction that is always rolled back.
